verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships no first-party SDK in the evidence. Instead, its docs say its OpenAI-compatible API works with any OpenAI SDK or client pointed at localhost:8080 [localai-docs-1, localai-docs-32]. They also say it supports the Anthropic Messages API for Claude clients [localai-docs-2, localai-docs-16], so developers build against third-party official SDKs rather than LocalAI's own. Probes found no published OpenAPI spec from which typed clients could be generated [localai-probe-3]. Missing for 10: a first-party LocalAI SDK, SDK documentation or reference, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of SDK compatibility.
